_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.68x; +39% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.30; conservative 2yr +26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.3%/yr (Q2 2022 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.3%/yr (FY12-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2022-10-14) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.68x (31.9% downside to Bear $132 / +46.6% upside to Bull $284) | Adj composite 2.60 vs market 2.30: gap +0.30 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $139 (14x FY22E $9.95) | Conservative 2-yr case: +26.4% total (+13.2%/yr) | At 19.5x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $256 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; carloads -1% in Q2 2022, forward revenue +14% (no FY22 revenue guide, Q2 2022 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
